hub.title: Offline cash
hub.subtitle: Turn your IOU into notes that spend hand-to-hand, with no network
hub.demoHint: Pay offline, settle on-chain, and watch a double-spend get convicted

hub.receiveHint: Take a note and verify it on the spot
hub.how: Your sarraf's IOU is locked on-chain into a batch of notes. Each note is a signed, verifiable claim you can hand to anyone — the recipient checks it fully offline (cert chain + your signature + the recipient binding). When either side is back online, the note settles on-chain to the recipient. Try to spend the same note twice and the chain convicts you: your collateral is seized and the honest victim is compensated.
